Saturday looks hot and dry, so High Park is a good bet. The Jamie Bell Adventure Playground, the wading pool and splash pads, and the free animal display (bison, llamas, peacocks) all suit a 5 and an 8 year old. It's on the west side by Bloor St W and Parkside Dr. The park is open daily, but the water play is seasonal, so I'd check that it's running before you go.

I didn't find a scheduled class or event for their ages that day. I'll look again tomorrow and text you if anything turns up.
